name: Sakagami Toshiya
source:
The protagonist of this work.

He's about to marry the older sister he'd harbored a faint crush on, and he's not sure whether to be happy or confused.

Living with this overly attentive older sister leaves him utterly bewildered.
　
[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/okusama/chara.html]official site[/url]]
